comment: cmd.c parse() turns a count into gm.multi before a nonmovement command. The counted ) runs doprwep(), whose ECMD_OK result makes rhack() reset the count after one display. The counted x runs doswapweapon(), which zeroes gm.multi itself, so the weapons swap once. The counted Ctrl-D runs dokick(), whose ECMD_TIME result leaves gm.multi for allmain.c moveloop_core() to re-enter rhack(gc.cmd_key), so the hero kicks at empty space three times, answering a fresh direction prompt each time, before the last l moves.
